records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Subscription revenue increased by $30.6 million during the three months ended October 31, 2023, compared to the same period a year ago, primarily due to the impact of cloud transition agreements and new subscription agreements entered into and provisioned since October 31, 2022, and the renewal or extension of subscription services at the fully ramped annual fees after the initial committed term.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have experienced seasonal variations in our license revenue and, to a lesser extent, in our subscription revenue as a result of increased customer orders in our fourth fiscal quarter, which is the quarter ending July 31.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The success of our sales efforts relies on continued improvements and enhancements to our current services and products, the introduction of new services and products, efficient operation of our cloud infrastructure, continued development of relevant local content and automated tools for updating content, and successful implementations and migrations.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Because we pay our services professionals the same amount throughout the year, our gross margins on our services revenue are usually lower in these quarters.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our business and financial results since the third quarter of fiscal year 2020 have been impacted due to these disruptions, which has affected our ARR growth rates, services revenue and margins, operating cash flow and expenses, potentially higher employee attrition, challenges in hiring and onboarding necessary personnel, and the change in fair value of strategic investments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Revenue: For the nine months ended October 31, 2023, revenue was $25.6 billion, an increase of 11 percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in subscription and support revenues for the three and nine months ended October 31, 2023 was primarily caused by volume-driven increases from new business, which includes new customers, upgrades, and additional subscriptions from existing customers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Remaining Performance Obligation: Total remaining performance obligation, which represents all future revenue under contract yet to be recognized, as of October 31, 2023 was approximately $48.3 billion, an increase of 21 percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three and nine months ended October 31, 2023, the increase in cost of revenues in absolute dollars was primarily due to an increase in service delivery costs which were partially offset by third-party expenses and amortization of purchased intangibles.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Income from Operations: For the nine months ended October 31, 2023, income from operations was $3.4 billion as compared to $0.7 billion from a year ago.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales from the Retail segment accounted for approximately 90.3% of consolidated net sales for the nine months ended October 31, 2023, compared to 91.7% for the comparable period in fiscal 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Comparable store net sales increased as higher store traffic and average unit retail price were partially offset by decreases in units per transaction, transactions and conversion rate.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total inventory at October 31, 2023, as compared to October 31, 2022, decreased by $22.6 million, or 3.0%, to $721.0 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Selling, general and administrative expenses increased by $45.7 million, or 15.2%, in the third quarter of fiscal 2024, compared to the third quarter of fiscal 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Income from operations was 8.5% of net sales, or $109.0 million, for the third quarter of fiscal 2024 compared to 4.9% of net sales, or $57.3 million, for the third quarter of fiscal 2023.
